notes.title: 🚨 Sheriff’s Update: The Road Ahead for HPS 🚨
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there, Sheriff!
[/p][p]Long time no see, my friend.[/p][p]
We're deep in the process of laying out the road, fixing potholes, adding flying tumbleweeds, and watering cacti that bring the desert to life.[/p][p]
But in all seriousness, we're here and we're building this game.[/p][p]
I know it's been quiet on our end for a while. Any obstacles we've hit are now in the rear mirror.[/p][p]
So stick around, because more updates are coming soon.[/p][p]And if you haven't already, make sure to add HPS to your wishlist![/p][p]

notes.title: Devlog#o1 / Our comedy of Errors!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Sheriff!

It's time for a hilarious vlog straight from our dev team. So, grab your water glasses, get comfy, and take a break to enjoy our funny film featuring some bloopers we encountered while working with the Unreal Engine.

[previewyoutube=uqdDxH-z16w;full][/previewyoutube]

And don't worry, all those pesky errors have already been fixed, and our car generator is running smoothly now. Although, we make it no secret that we would love to see your social media posts from similar situations if you were playing HPS for seriously.

Who knows, we might even throw in a special easter egg just for you, our awesome community.

And if you want to support us, then don't forget to add Highway Patrol Simulator to the wishlist. Your interest is the best motivation for us!

notes.title: Toss us your story - and we'll pay your fines
notes.notes:
Howdy, Sheriff!

Have you had yourself one heck of an adventure on the road with a run-in with the highway patrol lately? Well, partner, don't keep it all to yourself! Share your wild tale and have a shot at winning your very own copy of the game!

[previewyoutube=t0XoCbA4CzY;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, hold onto your police hat, 'cause we've got some mighty exciting news for ya. You've got a golden opportunity to become a real-life part of the epic Highway Patrol Simulator!

We're fixin' to run a contest where you can lay down your precious road experience, and we'll weave it right into our top-notch simulator. So, what are you waitin' for? Saddle up and join the ride!

We wanna hear all about your wild road stories. Was it a spine-chillin' encounter on a lonesome road in the dead of night? Maybe a knee-slappin' moment during a routine check? Or reckon you've been part of a wild chase on the freeway?

Share with us your favorite moments that made your heart skip a beat, brought tears of laughter to your eyes, or taught you a thing or two about life on the road.

Why's it worth it, ya ask? The best stories will be put on the “Highway Patrol Simulator.”  And as an added bonus, winners'll snag a free copy of the game and their names will be performed into the credits.

Don't dilly-dally, partner — submit your story right here: [url=hello@pixeltrapps.games][here] [/url]

We can't thank y'all enough for your support and dedication, 'cause it's you who's the backbone of this project!

Catch ya on the road,

The “Highway Patrol Simulator” Team.

[url=https://discord.gg/sdZYUVnEa2]Join our discord![/url]

notes.title: Hey, everyone! 👋🥳
notes.notes:
Howdy Sheriff!

Boy, do we have some good news for ya! Our special detective squad has finally snagged some mighty valuable intel you've been eagerly waitin' for. There's a list of folks responsible for the project called Highway Patrol Simulator sittin' on your desk. Been catchin' our interest for quite some time, I tell ya. And guess what? We managed to intercept their mysterious note too. You best take a gander at them names and let me know what ya think.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296342/1656ff4efc9d96f1b10a2f38b74f75d56d7fc4f3.png[/img]

We generously hand over to y'all our latest HPS trailer, hopin' y'all gonna receive it with a whole gotta enthusiasm. We just can't wait for ya to join us on an incredible adventure along the picturesque Route 66, where we'll be chasin' down them criminals. This simulator is one of our top goals for the year, so we encourage ya to keep track of our social media channels to stay up to date with the latest happenings.

See ya on duty! Pixel Trapps Games

Oh, wait, how rude of us, we haven't even introduced ourselves... Hi! We are a Pixel Trapps - 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296342/b25c2d22c47411e5e21452cb9fea30fb47b2da51.png[/img]

And before you go, please consider wishlisting our game if you haven't already -- it lets us know how much interest there is, and helps the game gain visibility 💖

P.S. 'Bout that “special detective squad” of ours, we're talkin' 'bout our remarkable grandma Bettie, who's demandin' a raise with all her might. Can't quite fathom how her “gatherin' information” differs from her daily bench sittin'.
